trait_scores.note: Lamps are round; brand uses tapered blades.
Stripe pair is present but offset to one side instead of centred.
Hatched crest sits on the hood at the reference angle.
Shoulder line rises toward the rear, slightly softer than the references.
Graphite body with one signal color; the accent covers more area than usual.

matches.text: The hatched crest sits correctly on the hood, at the reference angle.
Body finish reads as graphite with one signal color, matching the house style.
The shoulder line rises toward the rear the same way it does across the reference set.

departures.text: Headlights are rounded ovals — the brand signature is a tapered blade shape.
The centre stripe is offset to one side rather than centred on the hood.
Front overhang can't be judged from a front-only view; a side photo is needed.

directions.title: Sharpen the lamps
directions.rationale: Replace the round lamp graphic with a tapered blade that narrows toward the badge, matching the reference set.

directions.title: Centre the stripe
directions.rationale: Shift the stripe pair back onto the centreline of the hood so it reads as a single symmetric mark.

directions.title: Push further: new signature
directions.rationale: A single round unit paired with a wide lower colour block — a deliberately different look, worth flagging as an option outside the current DNA.
